description: Find available day plans around coordinates for a date and audience. Returns ids for get_day_plan. Does not create a new itinerary. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

audience.description: Who the plan is for: family (with children), couple, friends, or active (sporty). Omit for all.

cursor.description: Opaque page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same arguments. Omit for the first page.

date.description: Day of the outing, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Rome): only plans that can be followed that day. Omit for any upcoming day.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84) of the search centre, e.g. from resolve_location.

radius_m.description: Search radius in straight-line metres from lat/lng, 1000 to 100000. Default 30000 (30 km).

name: search_day_plans
title: Cerca itinerari
